snippet.title: Abyss Veil Chapter 1: Decay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: (coming out this week)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/36...


Abyss Veil is a anime-inspired, story-driven, psychological horror FPS that retraces the lives of Ivy and Mel in a war torn world. Meet strange folks, fight like hell, unravel strange mysteries, and most importantly, enjoy your stay!

note: This is my first game ever, and has mostly been a learning project to get the hang around what its like making a game by myself. What started as a fake game to showcase sound design in a portfolio turned into a whole game lol. So I figured itd be a waste to leave it as nothing but a fake game, and actually turn it into something. Learned how to use blender3d, godot, even how to draw bad neko neko sugar girls tier cgs. 

#indiegames #indiegame #fps #horror #psychologicalhorror
